entries.label_vi: Giữ gìn pháp luật: công dân tuân thủ tự nguyện và hợp tác; nhà nước ban hành, điều tra, xét xử công bằng
entries.claim: A law is only as strong as the willingness of citizens to follow it.
entries.because: Most laws are obeyed voluntarily and police cannot watch everyone, but only the state can make fair laws, investigate crimes and punish offenders lawfully.
entries.result: Citizens and government each carry part of the responsibility.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề trách nhiệm thực thi pháp luật.

entries.text: A driver who stops at a red light on an empty road, for example, shows a respect for rules that no number of cameras could produce.
